title: pilosella procera
intro: Pilosella procera, commonly known as False Fox-Glove, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in treating various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella procera include its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe digestive issues, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
